column1: # ComfyUI model weights for the S, V and L stages, pinned to a Hugging Face revision.
# scripts/setup_env.sh downloads each file to $COMFYUI_DIR/models/_hf/<repo>/<path> and links it into
# $COMFYUI_DIR/models/<dest>/. Weights are regenerable and never go in this repo.
# fp8/fp4 variants throughout: the 5090 has 32 GB of VRAM and the box has 38 GB of RAM.
